before:
nesnd_reform_politics_tt: "#bold 内阁与地方失序#!
已实行新的地权制度时，政府内强大的地主[concept_interest_group]若[concept_approval]至多为#v −5#!，每月增加#n 0.25#!失序。

政府内强大的乡村民众、实业家或知识分子中，只要有一组支持度至少为#v 5#!，每月减少#p 0.25#!失序；多组符合时仍只计算一次。两项可以同时生效。

[Concept('concept_unemployed','$concept_unemployment$')]、生活水平、教育及行政条件继续决定改革成果。战争、[concept_bankruptcy]后的惩罚期和持续民生危机按原规则增加压力。"
after: nesnd_reform_politics_tt:0 "地方失序"

before: nesnd_cne_land_status:0 "农业开发与土地流转，是本项改革的建设条件。\n$nesnd_cne_land_requirements$\n最终巩固仍需实行自耕农、商业化农业或集体化农业。运行期间每月增加#p 0.25#!改革进度；农业条件失去或暂停后停止本项收益。"
after: nesnd_cne_land_status:0 "$nesnd_cne_land_requirements$\n土地产权须确立为自耕农、商业化农业或集体化农业。"

before:
nesnd_cne_urban_status:0 "城镇须有持续的产业与救济承接人口。
$nesnd_cne_urban_requirements$
运行期间每月增加#p 0.35#!改革进度；产业与福利条件失去时暂停。
#tooltippable #tooltip:[ROOT.GetCountry.GetTooltipTag],nesnd_cne_consolidation_rules 就业、教育与福利的巩固条件#!#!
下方拨款先展示具体目标州，确认后支付。"
after: nesnd_cne_urban_status:0 "$nesnd_cne_urban_requirements$\n#tooltippable #tooltip:[ROOT.GetCountry.GetTooltipTag],nesnd_cne_consolidation_rules 就业、教育与福利#!#!"

before: nesnd_cne_camps_status:0 "正在清理营产的地区：#v [ROOT.GetCountry.MakeScope.Var('nesnd_cne_camps_active').GetValue|0]#!。每州每月增加#p 0.05#!改革进度，并分别引起军队反对。\n各省可独立开始或暂停；主改革结束后，一切营产清理收益与代价随之撤回。"
after: nesnd_cne_camps_status:0 "正在整顿营产的地区：#v [ROOT.GetCountry.MakeScope.Var('nesnd_cne_camps_active').GetValue|0]#!。"

before: nesnd_cne_land_start_button_desc:0 "把这项改革付诸实行，承担其中的财政与政治责任。"
after: nesnd_cne_land_start_button_desc:0 "丈量田亩，疏通买卖，让土地与农民脱离宗族的束缚。"

before: nesnd_cne_urban_start_button_desc:0 "把这项改革付诸实行，承担其中的财政与政治责任。"
after: nesnd_cne_urban_start_button_desc:0 "以工坊、矿业与城镇建设吸纳乡民，并使救济随新产业一道扩展。"

before: nesnd_cne_land_stop_button_desc:0 "暂缓推行，撤去本项的临时收益与政治代价。"
after: nesnd_cne_land_stop_button_desc:0 "暂缓田亩清丈与转让，召回地方承办官员。"

before: nesnd_cne_urban_stop_button_desc:0 "暂缓推行，撤去本项的临时收益与政治代价。"
after: nesnd_cne_urban_stop_button_desc:0 "暂缓官办迁业与城镇扩建，收回本项拨助。"

before: nesnd_cne_land_stop_tt:0 "停止本项月度进度，撤回本项所有临时收益与利益集团影响。"
after: nesnd_cne_land_stop_tt:0 "停止土地商品化带来的进度增长、信心消耗及临时修正。"

before: nesnd_cne_urban_stop_tt:0 "停止本项月度进度，撤回本项所有临时收益与利益集团影响。"
after: nesnd_cne_urban_stop_tt:0 "停止国家城市化带来的进度增长、信心消耗及临时修正。"

before: nesnd_cne_start_requirements:0 "主改革进行中，行政力非负、未破产、地方失序低于65，且仍拥有该州。"
after: nesnd_cne_start_requirements:0 "地权革命尚未结束；行政力非负、未受破产惩罚、地方失序低于65，且拥有该州。"

before: nesnd_cne_funding_requirements:0 "主改革仍在进行，国库足够，年度冷却已结束，且没有另一份等待答复的拨款案。"
after: nesnd_cne_funding_requirements:0 "地权革命尚未结束，国库足够，距上次拨款至少一年，且没有待答复的拨款案。"

before: nesnd_land_survey_outcome_tt:0 "先拟定拨款案。确认事件将指向当前符合条件、失业率最高的州，并列出国库支出、建设、资质与教育收益；确认前不扣款。"
after: nesnd_land_survey_outcome_tt:0 "为失业率最高的州拟定实业拨款，呈请批准。"

before: nesnd_land_military_outcome_tt:0 "先拟定救济案。确认事件将指向有欠食人口且失业率最高的合格州，列出支出、额外救济及期限；确认前不扣款。"
after: nesnd_land_military_outcome_tt:0 "为欠食人口所在、失业率最高的州拟定救济拨款，呈请批准。"

before: nesnd_cne_funding.1.d:0 "[SCOPE.sState('nesnd_cne_funding_state').GetName]正承受人口转业的压力。官府拟拨款扶助工坊与实业学堂，使离开田庄的人能够取得新工作的资格。款项落实后，当地将获得一年的建设、职业资质与教育收益；实际招工仍须依靠工厂经营和劳动者的选择。"
after: nesnd_cne_funding.1.d:0 "[SCOPE.sState('nesnd_cne_funding_state').GetName]的清丈官奏报，离开田庄的乡民日益增多，许多人尚不熟悉工坊所需的手艺。官府请求拨款兴办实业学堂，并扶助当地工坊扩建，使这些人能够在城镇谋生。"

before: nesnd_cne_funding.2.d:0 "[SCOPE.sState('nesnd_cne_funding_state').GetName]的救济机关请求增拨款项。失去收入的家庭正在节省口粮，寻找工作的日子却不会因此缩短。朝廷可以增加一年的救济给付，让他们等待新工坊招人；地方的长期生计，仍有赖于产业与工资的改善。"
after: nesnd_cne_funding.2.d:0 "[SCOPE.sState('nesnd_cne_funding_state').GetName]的救济机关请求增拨款项。失去收入的家庭已经开始减少口粮，城内的招工尚不足以安置他们。朝廷须决定是否加发一年的救济，供这些家庭度过转业的难关。"

before: ce_cne_land_reform_goal:0 "推行各项子改革，改善民生与制度，并使改革成果连续巩固十二个月。"
after: ce_cne_land_reform_goal:0 "推行土地商品化、国家城市化与营产改制，巩固地权革命的成果。"

before: nesnd_cne_land_start_tt:0 "每月改革进度#p +0.25#!。军功爵支持#n −2#!、乡村民众支持#n −1#!；地主吸引力#n −15%#!、实业家吸引力#p +15%#!，不增加实业家支持。立法成功率#p +5个百分点#!、最低工资#p +5%#!。"
after: nesnd_cne_land_start_tt:0 "每月改革进度#p +0.25#!。军功爵支持#n −2#!、乡村民众支持#n −1#!；地主吸引力#n −15%#!、实业家吸引力#p +15%#!。立法成功率#p +5个百分点#!、最低工资#p +5%#!。 每年消耗人民的信心#n 10#!。"

before: nesnd_cne_urban_start_tt:0 "每月改革进度#p +0.35#!。儒生支持#n −2#!、实业家支持#n −1#!；小市民吸引力#p +15%#!。立法成功率#p +5个百分点#!、最低工资#p +5%#!。"

before: nesnd_cne_camp_start_tt:0 "本州每月增加#p 0.05#!改革进度。农业、矿业吞吐量各#p +10%#!，税收能力与建造速度各#p +10%#!。本州单独使军队支持#n −1#!、全体在职陆海军将领忠诚#n −1#!；同时推进多州会叠加。"
after: nesnd_cne_camp_start_tt:0 "本州每月增加#p 0.05#!改革进度。农业、矿业吞吐量各#p +10%#!，税收能力与建造速度各#p +10%#!。军队支持#n −1#!、全体在职陆海军将领忠诚#n −1#!；同时推进多州会叠加。 每年消耗人民的信心#n 10#!。"

before:
nesnd_reform_politics_tt: "#bold Cabinet and local disorder#!
After the land-rights requirements are met, a powerful Landowner [concept_interest_group] in government with [concept_approval] at most #v −5#! adds #n 0.25#! disorder each month.

A powerful Rural Folk, Industrialist, or Intelligentsia group in government with approval at least #v 5#! reduces monthly disorder by #p 0.25#!. Multiple qualifying groups grant this reduction once. Both effects can apply together.

[Concept('concept_unemployed','$concept_unemployment$')], living standards, education, and administration still determine reform outcomes. War, the penalty period following [concept_bankruptcy], and prolonged hardship retain their existing effects."
after: nesnd_reform_politics_tt:0 "Local disorder"

before: nesnd_cne_land_status:0 "Agricultural development supports the transfer of land.\n$nesnd_cne_land_requirements$\nFinal consolidation also requires Peasant Proprietorship, Commercialized Agriculture or Collectivized Agriculture. While active: #p +0.25#! monthly reform progress. Lost agricultural prerequisites or a pause end these benefits."
after: nesnd_cne_land_status:0 "$nesnd_cne_land_requirements$\nEstablish peasant proprietorship, commercialised agriculture or collectivised agriculture."

before:
nesnd_cne_urban_status:0 "Towns require industry and welfare to absorb population.
$nesnd_cne_urban_requirements$
While active: #p +0.35#! monthly reform progress. Losing industrial or welfare prerequisites pauses the programme.
#tooltippable #tooltip:[ROOT.GetCountry.GetTooltipTag],nesnd_cne_consolidation_rules Employment, education and welfare consolidation#!#!
Funding proposals identify the state before payment."
after: nesnd_cne_urban_status:0 "$nesnd_cne_urban_requirements$\n#tooltippable #tooltip:[ROOT.GetCountry.GetTooltipTag],nesnd_cne_consolidation_rules Employment, education and welfare#!#!"

before: nesnd_cne_camps_status:0 "Active estate programmes: #v [ROOT.GetCountry.MakeScope.Var('nesnd_cne_camps_active').GetValue|0]#!. Each adds #p 0.05#! reform progress monthly and its own military opposition.\nEach state can be started or paused separately. All temporary effects end with the parent reform."
after: nesnd_cne_camps_status:0 "States reorganising military estates: #v [ROOT.GetCountry.MakeScope.Var('nesnd_cne_camps_active').GetValue|0]#!."

before: nesnd_cne_land_start_button_desc:0 "Put this programme into effect, with its fiscal and political consequences."
after: nesnd_cne_land_start_button_desc:0 "Survey fields and open land transfers, freeing land and peasants from clan control."

after: nesnd_cne_urban_start_button_desc:0 "Expand workshops, mines and towns, with relief for the workers arriving there."

after: nesnd_cne_land_stop_button_desc:0 "Suspend land surveys and transfers and recall the officials responsible."

before: nesnd_cne_urban_stop_button_desc:0 "Suspend this programme and withdraw its temporary benefits and political costs."
after: nesnd_cne_urban_stop_button_desc:0 "Suspend the state-sponsored resettlement and urban expansion programme."

before: nesnd_cne_land_stop_tt:0 "Stop this programme’s monthly progress and remove all of its temporary benefits and interest-group effects."
after: nesnd_cne_land_stop_tt:0 "End the progress, confidence cost and temporary modifiers of land commercialisation."

before: nesnd_cne_urban_stop_tt:0 "Stop this programme’s monthly progress and remove all of its temporary benefits and interest-group effects."
after: nesnd_cne_urban_stop_tt:0 "End the progress, confidence cost and temporary modifiers of urbanisation."

before: nesnd_cne_start_requirements:0 "The reform is active; bureaucracy is non-negative, the country is not bankrupt, disorder is below 65, and the state is still owned."
after: nesnd_cne_start_requirements:0 "Land reform remains active; nonnegative bureaucracy, no bankruptcy penalty, disorder below 65, and ownership of the state."

before: nesnd_cne_funding_requirements:0 "The reform is active, funds are available, the annual cooldown has ended, and no other funding proposal awaits a response."
after: nesnd_cne_funding_requirements:0 "Land reform remains active, the treasury can meet the cost, a year has passed since the previous grant, and no proposal awaits a reply."

after: nesnd_land_survey_outcome_tt:0 "Submit an industrial grant for the state with the highest unemployment."

before: nesnd_land_military_outcome_tt:0 "Open a relief proposal for the eligible starving state with the highest unemployment. The event identifies the state, cost, welfare effect and duration before any payment."
after: nesnd_land_military_outcome_tt:0 "Submit relief for the eligible state with hungry inhabitants and the highest unemployment."

before: nesnd_cne_funding.1.d:0 "[SCOPE.sState('nesnd_cne_funding_state').GetName] faces the pressures of economic transition. Funding workshops and technical education will improve construction, qualifications and education for one year. Actual hiring still depends on viable enterprises and workers finding suitable jobs."
after: nesnd_cne_funding.1.d:0 "Officials in [SCOPE.sState('nesnd_cne_funding_state').GetName] report growing numbers of peasants leaving the estates without the skills required by workshops. They request funds for technical schools and industrial expansion to help these people find work in town."

before: nesnd_cne_funding.2.d:0 "Relief offices in [SCOPE.sState('nesnd_cne_funding_state').GetName] request additional funds. Families without income are cutting their meals while they search for work. One year of additional welfare can ease this transition; lasting livelihoods still require productive employment and wages."
after: nesnd_cne_funding.2.d:0 "Relief offices in [SCOPE.sState('nesnd_cne_funding_state').GetName] request additional funds. Families without an income are cutting their meals, and employers have not yet absorbed them. The court must decide whether to grant a year of additional relief."

before: ce_cne_land_reform_goal:0 "Pursue the reform programmes, improve institutions and living conditions, and sustain the gains for twelve months."
after: ce_cne_land_reform_goal:0 "Advance land commercialisation, urbanisation and military-estate reform, and consolidate the land revolution."
